name: John Oliver
monologue: John Oliver discusses FBI Director Kash Patel’s presence at the Olympic Games, why his work trips look an awful lot like vacations, and why he seems more interested in “working the media” than working his actual job. Then, Oliver explains why police body cameras can be useful, or useless, depending on whether they’re used properly, and why YouTube may have been a mistake – no matter how many videos there are of goats screaming.

name: John Oliver
monologue: Welcome, welcome, welcome to “Last Week Tonight!” I’m John Oliver. Thank you so much for joining us. It has been a busy week – and I mean really busy.

name: John Oliver
monologue: Trump, against zero odds, delivered the longest State of the Union in history.

name: John Oliver
monologue: The U.S. and Israel attacked Iran, with Israeli officials claiming they’ve killed the Ayatollah Khamenei – and look: we’re taping this on Saturday, so who the fuck knows what’s happened by the time you see this?

name: John Oliver
monologue: Meanwhile, the Clintons testified at the Epstein hearings.

name: John Oliver
monologue: And it turns out, we might be getting a new business daddy.

name: John Oliver
monologue: Netflix has backed out of its bid to buy Warner Bros. Discovery, paving the way for rival Paramount Skydance to take over.

name: John Oliver
monologue: Yeah, not great news! In fact, if I may quote anyone who’s ever accidentally sat on their Roku remote, “Oh shit, I’m in Paramount now, how the fuck do I get out of this?
